story_type: booster returns with a sonic boom and lands
hook: A rocket booster fell out of the sky with a sonic boom.
narration: This booster fell from the sky with a sonic boom and landed upright.
Minutes earlier, it had lifted a satellite off Vandenberg Air Force Base in California.
A camera on the rocket watched the coastline fall away beneath the flames.
Then the booster let go, and the upper stage pushed on alone toward orbit.
Boosters relight their engines to turn back, then fire once more to land.
outcome: The booster touched down near its launch site, and the Sentinel-6 satellite flew free in orbit.
title: Rocket booster lands with a sonic boom
description:
On Nov. 21, 2020, a SpaceX Falcon 9 launched the Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich ocean satellite from Vandenberg Air Force Base, California, and its first stage flew back and landed.

Footage: NASA JPL video, via the NASA Image and Video Library: https://images.nasa.gov/details/JPL-20201121-SENT6f-0002-Sentinel%206%20Launch%20Wrap%20Video
